findings.summary: Completion receipts are internally consistent but remain valid after the analyzed source changes
findings.evidence: Resolved. decision_analysis_files stores repository-relative path, content digest, and permission mode, and analysis_complete recomputes all three against the canonical live path (lib/arch_tools/arch_db.ml:395-425). The clean isolated selftest-impact fixture produced valid zero-finding evidence while unchanged, rejected it after chmod 0600, rejected it after a body-only conditional replacement with stable symbol identity, and confirmed reindex removed all decision/effect completion keys. selftest-effects independently confirmed a complete effect receipt becomes NOT_COMPUTED after rebuild/reindex.
findings.implementation_evidence: Arch_index_support.invalidate_analysis deletes decision/effect results, analysis universes, and completion metadata inside the destructive rebuild transaction (lib/arch_index/arch_index_support.ml:101-110; lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:124-128).

findings.summary: Untracked special-file mutations are invisible to the PCC target manifest
findings.evidence: Resolved. pcc-target-manifest now performs an ignore-aware filesystem walk and records special paths from lstat metadata without opening them. Exact pre-existing FIFO reproduction returned exit 3, status=refused, ok=false, request_mismatches=[special_file_unsupported], and left the FIFO present. The clean selftest-pcc failing-build fixture created an untracked FIFO and returned refusal/3 with mutation_detected=true and failure_stage=dune_build.
findings.implementation_evidence: pcc-evidence explicitly converts special manifest entries into special_file_unsupported refusals (scripts/pcc/pcc-evidence:66-69,112-115), while every post-capture pcc-index failure takes a final manifest and gives mutation precedence.

findings.summary: Completion metadata was shape-checked but not bound to source, index, universe, or result rows
findings.evidence: Resolved by run-scoped decision_analysis_files/analysis_run_id data and consumer recomputation of universe, index, and result digests. selftest-impact.sh, selftest-decision-lint.sh, and selftest-effects.sh reject metadata, result-row, universe, and run-ID tampering.
findings.fix: Implemented; the remaining live-input freshness gap is tracked separately.

findings.summary: Effect consumers queried a column absent from the shipped schema
findings.evidence: Resolved: arch-rules now selects function_name/value_kind/target and arch-impact selects value_kind/target. selftest-effects.sh passes shipped-schema clean, violation, partial, tamper, and replay paths.

findings.summary: pcc-index skipped mutation comparison on failing build and analyzer paths
findings.evidence: Resolved for manifestable mutations: all post-capture failure stages route through finalize_failure. Exact former reproduction now returns exit 3, status=refused, mutation_detected=true, failure_stage=dune_build. selftest-pcc adds build, callgraph, and decision-lint failure fixtures.
findings.fix: Implemented; the special-file visibility limitation is tracked separately.

findings.summary: Release verification checked staging instead of the final archive
findings.evidence: Resolved: scripts/package-release creates and then validates the final tar.gz; the release job uploads that archive, the tag-free matrix runs the same path, and selftest-release-manifest.sh passes missing/extra/wrong-mode/private-MCP negative archives.
